ForgeTrust.AppSurface.Cli v0.1.0

USAGE
  appsurface docs [options]
  appsurface docs [command] ...

DESCRIPTION
  Preview AppSurface Docs for a repository. Related: docs preview, docs export.

OPTIONS
  -u|--urls         URL binding forwarded to the AppSurface Docs host, for example http://127.0.0.1:5189. 
  -p|--port         Port shortcut forwarded to the AppSurface Docs host. 
  --all-hosts       Bind --port previews to localhost and all hosts instead of localhost only. Default: <false>.
  --strict          Fail startup when every configured AppSurface Docs harvester fails. Default: <false>.
  -r|--repo         Repository root to harvest (default: current directory). Default: <.>.
  --route-root      Route-family root for AppSurface Docs version and archive routes. 
  --docs-root       Live docs root path. 
  --public-origin   Public origin used for absolute AppSurface Docs canonical metadata. 
  -e|--environment  Host environment forwarded to the AppSurface Docs host. 
  --startup-timeout-seconds  Seconds to wait for the AppSurface Docs web host to start before failing fast. Use 0 to disable. Default: <10>.
  -h|--help         Shows help text. Default: <false>.

COMMANDS
  export            Export AppSurface Docs for a repository to static files. 
  preview           Preview AppSurface Docs for a repository. 
  verify-health     Verify AppSurface Docs harvest health for CI and release gates. 

You can run "appsurface docs [command] --help" to show help for a specific command.

ForgeTrust.AppSurface.Cli v0.1.0

USAGE
  appsurface export [options]

DESCRIPTION
  Export an AppSurface/RazorWire application to static or hybrid files.

OPTIONS
  -o|--output       Output directory for exported files (default: dist). Default: <dist>.
  --seeds           Path to a file containing seed routes. 
  -m|--mode         Export mode: cdn (default) or hybrid. Choices: "Cdn", "Hybrid". Default: <Cdn>.
  -u|--url          Base URL of a running application to crawl. 
  -p|--project      Path to a .csproj to run and export. 
  -d|--dll          Path to a .dll to run and export. 
  -f|--framework    Target framework (required for multi-target projects). 
  --app-args        Repeatable app argument token to pass through to the launched target app. 
  --no-build        Project mode only: skip build before launch. Default: <false>.
  --public-origin   Public static origin for same-origin canonical metadata, such as https://www.example.com. 
  --live-origin     Live origin for RazorWire-managed hybrid interactions, such as https://api.example.com. 
  --hybrid-credentials  Hybrid credentials mode: auto (default), include, or omit. Choices: "Auto", "Include", "Omit". Default: <Auto>.
  -h|--help         Shows help text. Default: <false>.

ForgeTrust.AppSurface.Cli v0.1.0

USAGE
  appsurface docs export [options]

DESCRIPTION
  Export AppSurface Docs for a repository to static files.

OPTIONS
  -o|--output       Output directory for exported static docs (default: dist/docs). Default: <dist/docs>.
  -m|--mode         Export mode: cdn (default) or hybrid. Choices: "Cdn", "Hybrid". Default: <Cdn>.
  --live-origin     Live origin for RazorWire-managed hybrid interactions, such as https://api.example.com. 
  --hybrid-credentials  Hybrid credentials mode: auto (default), include, or omit. Choices: "Auto", "Include", "Omit". Default: <Auto>.
  --redirects       Redirect strategy: html (default) or netlify. Choices: "Html", "Netlify". Default: <Html>.
  --seeds           Path to a file containing seed routes. Defaults to / and the configured docs root. 
  --strict          Fail startup when every configured AppSurface Docs harvester fails. Default: <false>.
  -r|--repo         Repository root to harvest (default: current directory). Default: <.>.
  --route-root      Route-family root for AppSurface Docs version and archive routes. 
  --docs-root       Live docs root path. 
  --public-origin   Public origin used for absolute AppSurface Docs canonical metadata. 
  -e|--environment  Host environment forwarded to the AppSurface Docs host. 
  --startup-timeout-seconds  Seconds to wait for the AppSurface Docs web host to start before failing fast. Use 0 to disable. Default: <10>.
  -h|--help         Shows help text. Default: <false>.
